svg.title: Networking and the request pipeline
svg.desc: net/, concurrent/, protocol/. The epoll thread only accepts sockets and queues work; a ThreadPool worker decodes WebSocket frames, and RequestPipeline runs SealOpen → ParseJson → Auth → Dispatch before any game code runs. Replies leave through a MessageSink.
svg.text: net/, concurrent/, protocol/. The epoll thread only accepts sockets and queues work; a ThreadPool worker decodes WebSocket frames,
and RequestPipeline runs SealOpen → ParseJson → Auth → Dispatch before any game code runs. Replies leave through a MessageSink.
- run_typed(entry, conn, msg) : void // new sink per call
Raw (auth family, SealOpen only): login, register, ...
